challenges.title: Caesar's Secret
challenges.description: Julius left you a message. Can you decode it?

hints.content: The ancient Romans shifted their alphabet to secure messages. Try shifting the letters backwards by 3 positions (ROT-3).

challenges.title: Cookie Monster
challenges.description: Only admins are allowed. You don't have credentials — but maybe you don't need them.

hints.content: Check your browser cookies. The 'role' cookie might be holding you back.

challenges.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
challenges.description: Here's a cute cat image. Or is it just a cat? Download it and investigate.

hints.content: Images can contain hidden zip folders or appended text data. Have you tried checking strings or running binwalk/exiftool?

challenges.title: Base Jumping
challenges.description: Sometimes secrets are just hiding in plain encoding.

hints.content: The string looks like it is encoded in Base64 (starts with FLAG in base64 equivalent, or has equal signs padding). Try decoding it.

challenges.title: GitLeaks
challenges.description: A developer accidentally committed something they shouldn't have. Dig through the commit history.

hints.content: Look at the commit log using git log -p to check deleted or modified lines.

challenges.title: Broken Vault
challenges.description: An insecure document search vault is online at `/vault-search`. Find the hidden flag inside the vault by abusing the query logic.

hints.content: The SQL query is vulnerable to SQL injection. Try searching for `' OR 1=1 --` or using UNION queries to query from the 'secrets' table.

challenges.title: Whisper Protocol
challenges.description: A secret transmission was intercepted. It is hex-encoded and encrypted with a repeating 3-character uppercase XOR key. Decrypt it to find the flag.

hints.content: The ciphertext is hex-encoded. The key is 3 uppercase characters. You can brute-force it or analyze frequency of characters since XOR cipher is weak.
